wbbse_source: অতীত ও ঐতিহ্য, Class VIII (WBBSE). Page numbers below are PDF page numbers (= OCR file number). The printed page number is PDF page minus 10 (e.g. PDF 423 = printed ৪১৩).
method: Every student-facing fact (sections standard/deep/boxes, events, people, timeline, terms, cause_effect, exam_focus, bengal_connection, quick_revision) and all 43 questions (answer + explanation) were compared with the WBBSE chapter 'জাতীয়তাবাদের প্রাথমিক বিকাশ' (PDF pp. 371-460) plus the communal-politics section (pp. 560-567) and the chronology (pp. 657-658). Quotes come from the OCR; the items marked 'image-checked' were confirmed on the rendered page image.
